==Dialogue==
:''"The [[Shard of Brilliance]] lying here before me is a magical contraption created for us by the renowned [[Master Engineer Jakumba]]. He has managed to focus the pure light of [[Dwayna]] into this crystalline shard from [[the Dragon's Lair (outpost)|the Dragon's Lair]]. Bring it with you into [[Ravenheart Gloom]]. It may well help you forge a path through the darkness. May the gods be with you."''
